_why: The SDK source tree uses uv-dynamic-versioning (pyproject.toml:5-6) and the read clone carries no git tags, so it cannot state its own version. `pydantic-ai-slim==2.35.0` in requirements.txt is a LABEL; these digests are the assertion. Review proved the distinction mattered TWICE: with only the version pin, external.py could be edited and all 18 gates still passed; with the five-file pin of round 2, native_tools/__init__.py -- the module that decides which tools may be ADMITTED -- was unpinned and could be edited with all 26 gates still passing.
_algorithm: sha256 of the file bytes, as installed under site-packages/pydantic_ai/
_coverage: verify_pin.REQUIRED_PINS, plus test_gate.py's AST scan of every pydantic_ai module harness.py or test_gate.py imports from. Regenerate deliberately with `python verify_pin.py --record`.
